question: Can the base-case reduction D(*|1) -> D(0|1) be constructively traced to RT_core while preserving distinction, admissibility, residue closure, and non-collapse?

disposition.summary: The base-case reduction is supported when the reduced field Red_x(D(0|0), D(0|1), D(1|1), D(0|1)) maps D(a|b) terms into RT_core-relevant distinction terms, selects x=0 as the unique admissible candidate under the declared local window, and preserves nonzero distinction, admissibility, residue closure, and non-collapse.

candidate_trace: Declare D(a|b) as a typed distinction relation in the base field.
Map each reduced D(a|b) term to RT_core-relevant distinction labels.
Evaluate the local admissibility window for the unresolved D(*|1) slot.
Select x=0 as the unique admissible candidate under the base field controls.
Verify E!=0 for the reduced field under the declared distinction representation.
Verify delta_a(E>0) is satisfied by the reduced field.
Verify iff_R residue closure links nonzero distinction and admissible realization.
Reject any trace step that collapses distinction, erases residue, or treats RT_core as a pre-given target.
formal_scaffold.candidate_rule: BaseTrace(D(*|1) -> D(0|1)) holds only if DistinctionPreserved, AdmSelected(x=0), ResidueClosed(iff_R), and NonCollapse all hold in the reduced field.
formal_scaffold.scope: model-relative recursive mechanics base case only

failure_conditions: The base-field D(a|b) terms are not typed as distinction relations.
The mapping from D(a|b) terms to RT_core-relevant distinction labels is missing.
x=0 is not uniquely admissible under the declared local admissibility window.
The reduced field fails E!=0 under the declared distinction representation.
delta_a(E>0) is not satisfied by the reduced field.
A trace step collapses distinction, erases residue, or aliases closure labels.
RT_core is treated as an external target rather than as the closure condition constituted by the trace.

remaining_work: Convert the campaign-supported trace scaffold into a formal proof artifact if theorem promotion is requested.
Run independent rigor endorsement before raising the induction ceiling.
Audit base-case uses for attempts to treat RT_core as a pre-given target.
Keep all three RT mechanics obligations bound together before any theorem-level promotion.

does_not_prove: Universal recursive soundness outside declared base-field controls.
Physical recurrence, conservation, or ontological permanence.
That RT_core is an external target hit by the base-case reduction.
